$comment: Ukrainian typography as macOS uk writes it (the reference pile's Finder/AppKit/System Settings strings, counted 2026-10-29): «…» primary (763 vs 16 curly), „…“ nested, the apostrophe is the LETTER ʼ (U+02BC, 212 hits, zero ASCII ' or ’ inside a word), so no ' or ’ is declared and either one is a finding; the single … hugging its word (262 vs 10 three-dot); a no-break space before % («100 %», «^0 % завершено») and before the dash — (14 no-break, 2 plain) with a space after. Hedges: every bracketed or slashed number, case, or gender ending, and a guessed ending on an insert. Rationale: docs/i18n/uk/style.md § Typography. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: a no-break space (U+00A0) goes before % (42 %), as macOS uk writes it
the dash — takes a no-break space (U+00A0) before it (Cmdr — файловий менеджер), as macOS uk writes it
the dash — takes a space after it
Ukrainian quotes hug their text: no space inside «…»

hedges.why: a bracketed number, case, or gender ending (файл(и), видалив(ла)); use ICU plural/select, or restructure
a slashed ending (елемент/и, готовий/а); use ICU plural/select, or restructure
a slashed pronoun hedging an unknown gender; repeat the type noun (сервер, папка) or rephrase
a case ending glued to a name Cmdr can't know ({name}а); put a type noun before it, quote it, or use a colon slot
